subject: ACME MAP: Technical evaluation plan — draft & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft: Technical evaluation plan (post-call recap)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps: I put together a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures the milestones we discussed; pushing this over so we can align on owners and target dates. High-level milestones (draft):

- Kickoff & environment access (owner: ACME eng) — target: 2026-03-05
- Technical evaluation (benchmarking) — (owner: Redwood/Cust eng) — target: 2 weeks after kickoff
- Procurement / SOW & security review — (owner: ACME procurement / Redwood legal) — target: 2026-03-22
- Pilot & validation — (owner: ACME product + Redwood CS) — target: 2026-04-05
- Finalize contract / go-live — target: 2026-04-15

MAP milestone we need to lock down now: Technical evaluation plan. Proposed scope in the attached "benchmark-specs.pdf":
- Success criteria: model quality parity (1-2% gap vs current baseline on ACME sample set), human-preferred responses >= 60% in blind A/B, and no high-confidence hallucinations for safety-critical prompts.
- Latency targets: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms for standard conversational flows (context window ~2k tokens).
- Cost targets: baseline target <= $0.12/token equivalent for 1M monthly tokens at quantized weights (we'll provide more granular cost estimates per model).
- Model shortlist to evaluate: Mistral-Instruct-7B, Llama-3-13B-quantized, Falcon-40B-instruct (quantized), and one ensemble baseline (Redwood lightweight L2 13B).

Dependencies: access to a representative sample dataset (non-PII; anonymized), test API keys/IP allowlist, SOC2 report, and firewall/VPN details for private eval if needed.

Next actions: can you confirm the ACME engineering point-of-contact for test access (we need someone to provide datasets and open any required ports), and whether procurement needs anything upfront for the SOW? I can schedule a 30m cadence weekly check-in — propose Tue 3/10 at 10am PT for the first benchmark sync.

Attached: ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx, benchmark-specs.pdf

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Technical evaluation plan (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — this looks useful. We're aligned on the overall milestones and the target close date of mid-April. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Our engineering lead for the eval will be Priya Narayanan (priya.n@acmecorp.com) — she'll own dataset sharing and firewall/VPN coordination.
- For latency: can you confirm whether the p95 target is measured with warm KV cache (steady-state)? We care most about steady-state p95 at the typical 8-12 token generation bursts we do.
- For cost: we need a cost-per-1M-token estimate per model in the shortlist (quantized vs non-quantized). If Redwood can run a quick cost sim based on our historical throughput (I'll attach a small metrics snapshot in a follow-up), that'd help procurement.
- Security: procurement looped in (procurement@acmecorp.com) and they'll need SOC2 Type II and a short runbook on data retention/retention-by-caller policies.

We'll aim to provide the sample dataset and initial metrics export by 3/4. Assuming that, can Redwood provide a recommended test harness and expected time to run the evaluation matrix for the four models?

Appreciate it — look forward to the proposed meeting on 3/10.

—Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of Product Integrations
Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com | 212-555-0158

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Technical evaluation plan (post-call recap)

Alex — perfect, thanks for the quick clarifications and for assigning Priya. Answers inline and updated ask list below.

- p95 measurement: yes — we'll report steady-state metrics with warm KV cache (we'll also capture cold-start numbers for completeness). We'll use the same request distribution you indicated (8-12 token generation bursts) unless Priya suggests otherwise.
- Cost estimates: Redwood will produce model-specific cost estimates (quantized and float variants) based on your historical throughput. We expect to have a first-pass cost-per-1M-token table by 3/6.
- Test harness & timeline: Redwood's benchmark harness (benchmark-specs.pdf) runs the following phases: data ingestion -> warmup -> steady-state runs (3 repeats) -> post-run quality evals. For the four models listed, with a 10k-sample test set typical run time is ~6-8 hours on our dedicated infra; we can parallelize across GPUs to shorten wall time.

Updated MAP milestone (Technical evaluation plan) — proposed owners & dates:
- Redwood: provide benchmark harness, run configs, and initial cost sims — owner: Mateo Alvarez — deliverable by 2026-03-06
- ACME: provide sample dataset and metrics export, grant test access / allowlist IPs — owner: Priya Narayanan — deliverable by 2026-03-04
- Redwood: run baseline tests & deliver results (latency/cost/quality) for shortlist — owner: Camila Reyes — deliverable by 2026-03-12
- Joint review session to go over results & next steps — propose 2026-03-15

Dependencies/reminders: SOC2 (we provided SOC2 link in the MAP), KMS key exchange if you want encrypted artifact storage, and an internal contact for firewall rules (Priya).

I'll upload the MAP v1 to the shared Drive and send the calendar invite for Tue 3/10 10am PT; we can move if that conflicts.

Attachments: updated MAP link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/acme-map-v1 (ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx), benchmark-specs.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa
